synthesis_checks: Every relied-on capture was rehashed against its content hash (241 regional, 139 wide).
The decisive status statement of every addition and status update was re-read in the capture.
Coordinate transforms and parcel or polygon centroids were recomputed independently.
Every addition was screened against all base sites, projects, evidence, source records and identity mappings by name, alias, operator, address and distance, and across both waves.
Both syntheses built and validated the update with the real builder for the update date.
integration_decisions: Galaxy Helios Phase II foundations (2026-08-12) was proposed by both waves from the same quarterly letter; the regional action is kept and the wide duplicate and its source are dropped.
Firmus Bell Bay DA 2026/29 is admitted as announced, not permitted, because a lodged TASCAT appeal means the granted permit has not taken effect; a hold records the reopen condition.
Microsoft Vaughan YTO11 is admitted as completed building construction only; operation is not established.
The update is dated 2026-10-16; several admissions leave the 90-day window if the update is dated after 2026-10-18.
residual_risks: Microsoft Silver Springs, Lyle Creek and BDx HKG8 use the page modification date as the observation date.
The three Shaoguan additions rest on an imagery-validated inferred CGCS2000 datum and are labelled compiled_reference / coordinate_transform.
Meta Eagle Mountain operational status rests on a general owns-and-operates statement.
OpenAI Project Camellia and Google Horndal property links are inferential and stated as such in the locator reviews.
Texas TDLR TABS registrations are used only for announced status.
collection_notes: Raw captures were stored outside the repository in git-ignored local_data directories and are not redistributed.

Copies fetched from apps.dca.ga.gov and requests made before robots.txt was read (echodata.epa.gov, frs-public.epa.gov and one City of Phoenix API path) were discarded; no admitted change relies on them.
